messages:
oliver: Heads-up: onboarding ferris14b-int4 on canary 1/3 hosts hitting memory spikes and occasional OOMs during long generations. Defaults: max_new_tokens=384, batching.max_batch_tokens=10240. fragmentation climbs ~0.79 before crash. anyone seen this pattern?

meera: paste from crash host quick dump:
```
GPU0 total=24576MB used=14600MB peak=14980MB
OOM at token_idx=372
mem_frag_ratio=0.79
transient_alloc_bytes=280MB
kv_prefetch=true
```
seems like a lot of transient temp buffers around KV prefetch + int4 kernels.

toni: yup, familiar. quick hedges: reduce max_new_tokens, tighten batch token cap, switch prefetch to adaptive/on-demand, and give the slot compactor more headroom. also cap per-request kernel scratch. suggested flags for canary:
```
redwood canary deploy --model ferris14b-int4 \
  --max_new_tokens 160 \
  --batching.max_batch_tokens 5120 \
  --batching.max_batch_size 6 \
  --runtime.kv.prefetch adaptive \
  --runtime.slot_compactor.threshold 0.55 \
  --runtime.kernel.scratch_cap_mb 180
```
That will trade some p50 latency for much lower peak working set and give the allocator room to coalesce freed pages.

oliver: applying on canary-1 now. thanks.

meera: quick microbench (500 warm + 1500 measured) against our prompt set:
- before (defaults): p50=110ms, p95=400ms, p99=950ms, avg GPU mem=14.6GB, OOM rate=1.7%
- after (max_new_tokens=160, batch_tokens=5120, prefetch=adaptive): p50=122ms, p95=210ms, p99=380ms, avg GPU mem=12.1GB, OOM rate=0.0%
Quality eval (200 prompts): rouge-L delta -0.9% (within canary threshold).

qa-bot: automated eval finished: smoke + regression checks passed. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/ferris14b/3551234567

toni: opening GH issue to track long-term fixes (allocator heuristics + kernel scratch policy): GH#4892. also proposing a CI perf job that toggles slot_compactor.threshold for quantized models so we catch this earlier.

infra-bot: canary deployment v1.0.3 for ferris14b-int4 started on 3 hosts  3/3 succeeded. logs: https://ci.redwood/canaries/3551234567

oliver: plan: keep canary live 8h, run full eval suite and production-sim traffic. if regressions <= 2% and no OOMs, we'll promote and set recommended defaults for int4 to max_new_tokens=160 and batching.max_batch_tokens=5120. I'll update the onboarding checklist and archive logs under /ml/onboard/ferris14b/int4/3551234567. Ping me if you see any spikes. :thumbsup:

meera: thanks team 1 saved the rollout.
